'''2011 German National Championship Cedrik Vanderhaegen DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage|V11-D-astunningmove.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
